item.text: I found the implementation and one upload call site. The existing decrypt parser can also throw on valid JSON with malformed nested values such as `Media: null`, so I’m tightening runtime guards alongside the types. For encryption, the object will replace the three metadata arguments while the two required key arguments remain separate, matching the repository’s encryption API.

The API and upload call site now use the options object, block sizes omit a zero remainder, and digest output is omitted when absent. I’m adding coverage for exact chunk boundaries and lower-case digest parsing, then I’ll run the Drive XAttr test and its type check if available.
